subject.title: fix(whatsapp): normalize hosted JIDs consistently with Baileys

question: Should upgrades with unresolved or conflicting LID-form WhatsApp allowlist entries fail closed and require Doctor-guided E.164 repair, as this PR proposes, or should OpenClaw preserve the prior authorization behavior temporarily through an explicit compatibility path?
rationale: Both outcomes intentionally define authorization for pre-existing user configuration. The choice cannot be resolved mechanically because the safe behavior trades strict identity verification against upgrade continuity.

options.title: Adopt verified-mapping-only migration
options.body: Keep the proposed fail-closed behavior: migrate only unambiguous verified mappings and leave unresolved LID entries for explicit operator repair with a Doctor warning.

options.title: Add temporary compatibility mode
options.body: Preserve existing LID-form authorization during a documented deprecation window while Doctor offers the canonical E.164 migration path.

recommendation.title: Adopt verified-mapping-only migration
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed fail-closed behavior: migrate only unambiguous verified mappings and leave unresolved LID entries for explicit operator repair with a Doctor warning.
